source: GROUND.md §6-7. Numbers from hollow-orbit js/game/items.js (tool damage and gather rates, clothing protection, consumables, stack sizes) and RustMVP inventory_survival.md (stack sizes); arrows, bow, spears and berries use Rust's numbers. G6: the vehicle workbench and the Tin Finch, a ship (ships.json) rather than something carried. G4: firearms, rounds and attachments get their numbers from weapons.json (their stack of 128 and the guns' magazines from RustMVP, condition per shot from hollow-orbit's dur: pistol 200, rifle 300); the metal mask is hollow-orbit's metal_facemask (50% against shots and blows to the head). Names are ours. IDs are stable: never reuse a retired one (saves and the wire use them).

items.name: Wood
items.description: Chopped from trees. Builds, crafts and burns.

items.name: Stone
items.description: Broken from stone outcrops. Stone tools, furnaces and stone buildings.

items.name: Metal ore
items.description: Smelt it in a furnace for metal fragments.

items.name: Sulphur ore
items.description: Smelt it in a furnace for sulphur.

items.name: High-grade ore
items.description: A rich vein in metal outcrops. Smelt it for refined metal.

items.name: Metal fragments
items.description: Basic metal for tools, armour and workbenches.

items.name: Sulphur
items.description: Kept for powder and explosives.

items.name: Refined metal
items.description: Strong metal for armour and the better workbenches.

items.name: Charcoal
items.description: Left over when wood burns in a fire or furnace.

items.name: Plant fibre
items.description: Pulled from fibre plants. Clothing, bandages, bags and bows.

items.name: Lamp oil
items.description: Rendered from charcoal and fibre. A furnace needs some to be built.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.description: Charcoal and sulphur, ground together. Every round of ammunition needs some.

items.name: Rock
items.description: A fist-sized rock. Knocks wood off trees and stone off outcrops; better than nothing in a fight.

items.name: Torch
items.description: Light in the dark. A poor tool and a poor weapon.

items.name: Stone hatchet
items.description: A sharpened stone on a handle. Chops trees.

items.name: Stone pickaxe
items.description: A pointed stone on a handle. Breaks stone and ore.

items.name: Metal hatchet
items.description: A forged blade. Chops trees fast.

items.name: Metal pickaxe
items.description: A forged pick. Mines stone and ore fast.

items.name: Wooden spear
items.description: A long sharpened pole. Reaches further than anything else in hand.

items.name: Stone spear
items.description: A wooden spear with a stone point.

items.name: Machete
items.description: A long forged blade. Quick cuts that bleed.

items.name: Bow
items.description: Hold the right mouse button to draw, click to loose an arrow. Arrows drop with distance.

items.name: Service pistol
items.description: A semi-automatic pistol with a 15-round magazine. One shot a click; it kicks straight up. Takes a sight, a muzzle attachment and a light.

items.name: Frontier rifle
items.description: A fully automatic rifle with a 30-round magazine. Its recoil follows the same pattern every burst: learn it and pull against it.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: A fletched shaft. Often survives a miss.

items.name: Pistol rounds
items.description: Ammunition for the service pistol.

items.name: High-velocity pistol rounds
items.description: Faster and flatter than plain pistol rounds, a little weaker.

items.name: Incendiary pistol rounds
items.description: Slow rounds that set what they hit burning.

items.name: Rifle rounds
items.description: Ammunition for the frontier rifle.

items.name: High-velocity rifle rounds
items.description: Faster and flatter than plain rifle rounds, a little weaker.

items.name: Incendiary rifle rounds
items.description: Slow rounds that set what they hit burning.

items.name: Holo sight
items.description: A reflex sight: a little magnification and tighter shots aimed down the sights.

items.name: 4x scope
items.description: Four times magnification for the rifle. Very tight shots when aimed.

items.name: Silencer
items.description: Hides the muzzle flash and quiets the shot. Less recoil and spread; slower, weaker rounds.

items.name: Weapon light
items.description: A light under the barrel, lit while the gun is in hand.

items.name: Muzzle brake
items.description: Halves the recoil, but the shots spread wider and hit a little softer.

items.name: Bandage
items.description: Stops bleeding and heals a little over time.

items.name: Medical injector
items.description: Heals at once and over time, and stops bleeding.

items.name: Red berries
items.description: Sweet and filling. A little food and water, and they help a wound heal.

items.name: Blue berries
items.description: Juicy. More water than food.

items.name: Wild tuber
items.description: Edible raw, but roast it on a campfire and it is a meal.

items.name: Roasted tuber
items.description: Hot and filling.

items.name: Woven hood
items.description: A hood of rough plant fibre.

items.name: Woven shirt
items.description: A rough shirt. Keeps you a little warmer.

items.name: Woven trousers
items.description: Rough trousers.

items.name: Woven gloves
items.description: Keeps your hands warm.

items.name: Work boots
items.description: Fibre boots with metal-shod soles.

items.name: Chest plate
items.description: Riveted metal plates over the chest, worn on top of a shirt.

items.name: Metal mask
items.description: A welded mask over the face and the crown of the head. Halves what a hit to the head does.

items.name: Sleeping bag
items.description: Place it and you can come back here after you die, every five minutes.

items.name: Bed
items.description: A frame and a mattress. You can come back here after you die, every two minutes.

items.name: Campfire
items.description: Burns wood for warmth and charcoal, and cooks food.

items.name: Furnace
items.description: Burns wood to smelt ore into metal and sulphur.

items.name: Small box
items.description: A wooden box with room for 18 stacks.

items.name: Large box
items.description: A big wooden box with room for 48 stacks.

items.name: Workbench, level 1
items.description: Crafts level 1 items within 4 metres of it.

items.name: Workbench, level 2
items.description: Crafts level 2 items within 4 metres of it.

items.name: Workbench, level 3
items.description: Crafts level 3 items within 4 metres of it.

items.name: Vehicle workbench
items.description: A heavy bench with a hoist and a parts rack. Builds ships; a finished one rolls out onto the ground in front of it.

items.name: Tin Finch
items.description: A one-seat salvage skiff: a pressure cabin, three rear exhausts and four lift nozzles. Burns lamp oil. Built at a vehicle workbench.
